"""The same file with the one change that makes it legal.

The string is walked against the admitted grammar and the object is built node
by node, so nothing the file supplies is handed to a parser that would evaluate
it. Everything else about the file is unchanged, which is what makes it a
neighbour rather than a different file.
"""

from findbuch.expression import parse_against_grammar


def load_hamiltonian(row, symbol_table):
    return parse_against_grammar(row["hamiltonian"], symbol_table)
